**Finding repaired and resubmitted: compliant** (no redline, no counterparty comment).

The only issue was the deterministic duration check, which returned a false negative because Section 19.2 writes the period in words ("ninety days") rather than digits. The rationale now records this expressly:

- **Duration** – "ninety days" = 90 days, measured from delivery **or acceptance, whichever is later** (so substantively longer than a bare 90 days); hosted Services conform "throughout the subscription term," i.e. the full three-year term under §8.1, which exceeds the preferred 12-month software benchmark.
- **Substance** – §19.1 professional/workmanlike by qualified personnel to industry standards plus material conformance to documentation and specifications; §19.3 no malicious code, Applicable Law compliance, no functionality diminution, open-source protection.
- **Remedy** – §19.4 re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Disclaimer** – §19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and cannot limit express warranties, service levels, indemnities or stated remedies; no "AS IS" walk-away exposure.

Retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation item.
